A group of nodes; as a Preparation Recipe it runs its steps as one stage.

**Status:** Not in the palette: Select two or more nodes, then right-click the canvas: Actions > Create Subgraph (Ctrl+Shift+U).

A visual group only tidies the canvas and does not run. A Preparation Recipe takes one dataset, runs its steps in order and gives one prepared dataset, exactly as the steps would as separate nodes.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Workflow](../categories/workflow.md) |
| Status | Made from other nodes |
| Search words | workflow, subgraph, group, recipe, preparation |

## Inputs

None: the node starts a branch of the graph.

## Outputs

None: the node ends a branch of the graph.

## Settings

The node has no settings.

The node runs on the device chosen for the run (CPU or a GPU); a node does not fix a device.

## Support

| Aspect | Value | Supported | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Implementation Owner | recipe lowering | Yes | A Preparation Recipe runs: it is lowered into its steps before the pipeline runs. A visual group only tidies the canvas and does not run. |
